gh.description: Flutter Tamper Detector is a security plugin for Flutter that detects and prevents tampering. It identifies if the device is rooted, if hooking tools like Frida, Xposed, or Cydia Substrate are present, or if the device is an emulator. It can automatically close the app to protect integrity and security.
